```python
def solve(case):
    nodes = case["nodes"]
    required_symbols = set(case["required_symbols"])
    
    # Validate required fields
    for node in nodes:
        for field in ["id", "parent", "symbol", "depth", "removable", "utility"]:
            if field not in node:
                raise ValueError(f"Missing field {field} in node")
    
    if "required_symbols" not in case:
        raise ValueError("Missing required_symbols")
    
    # Build children map
    children = {node["id"]: [] for node in nodes}
    root_id = None
    for node in nodes:
        if node["parent"] is None:
            root_id = node["id"]
        else:
            if node["parent"] not in children:
                raise ValueError(f"Parent {node['parent']} not found")
            children[node["parent"]].append(node["id"])
    
    if root_id is None:
        raise ValueError("No root node found")
    
    # Current retained set (all nodes initially)
    retained = {node["id"] for node in nodes}
    
    # Sort: deeper first, then by node ID for tie-breaking
    sorted_nodes = sorted(nodes, key=lambda n: (-n["depth"], n["id"]))
    
    removal_order = []
    
    for node in sorted_nodes:
        nid = node["id"]
        
        # Skip if not removable
        if not node["removable"]:
            continue
        
        # Skip if symbol is required
        if node["symbol"] in required_symbols:
            continue
        
        # Skip if has retained children
        has_retained_child = any(c in retained for c in children[nid])
        if has_retained_child:
            continue
        
        # Tentatively remove: check all required symbols still represented
        retained_without = retained - {nid}
        symbols_remaining = {n["symbol"] for n in nodes if n["id"] in retained_without}
        
        if required_symbols.issubset(symbols_remaining):
            retained = retained_without
            removal_order.append(nid)
    
    return {
        "removed_node_ids": removal_order,
        "retained_node_ids": sorted(retained)
    }
```
